description.value: Bar Asra is a South Granville cocktail lounge and share plates restaurant led by Executive Chefs Kanwardeep Ahluwalia and Baldeep Singh, whose backgrounds span 16 Taj properties, the 2010 Commonwealth Games, and Fairmont hotels in Vancouver and Lake Louise. The menu draws on global travel and memory — paneer tarts, crab satay, chargrilled steak — paired with a craft cocktail program featuring fat-washed gins, milk-clarified cachaca drinks, and zero-proof options. Free live acoustic music on select evenings makes it a distinctive neighbourhood spot steps from Downtown Vancouver and Kitsilano.
